summary.text: Becky Shields is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 15, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Matt Roach; they face incumbent Democrats Samantha Jacobs and Nicholas Germana.

paragraphs.text: Becky Shields and Matt Roach defeated Jerry Sickels in the Republican primary for Cheshire 15 on September 8, 2026.
